name: Edvaldo Baristan
description: Edvaldo Baristan is an aggressive banker who manages the North Ward branch of the Cassalanter Bank. Alongside his wife Christina, he is a secret member of the Cassalanter's cult and utilizes his ceremonial golden dagger as a letter opener.
ideals: Ambition: Advancing the wealth and influence of the Cassalanter banking empire while serving their secret dark faith.
bonds: The Cassalanter Bank North Ward branch.
His wife Christina Baristan and their three children.
flaws: Ruthless and aggressive in financial dealings and secretive cover-ups to protect the cult's dark activities.
speech_patterns: Professional, calculating, and authoritative, with a veneer of financial respectability masking a cold, calculating nature.
mannerisms: Uses his ceremonial golden dagger as a casual letter opener on his desk and maintains an air of wealthy composure while managing loans and debt collections.

relationships.name: Christina Baristan
relationships.relationship: Wife / City Watch Administrator / Cult Co-conspirator

motivations: To manage financial assets for the Cassalanters, entrap debtors or secure leverage for the bank, and advance the cult's goals.
knowledge: Expertise in financial banking operations, loan contracts, debt collection, and local noble financial networks in the North Ward.
gm_notes: Edvaldo Baristan serves as a key financial and cult antagonist for the party. He can be used when adventurers seek loans for Trollskull Manor—offering dangerous contracts that involve high-risk default clauses or indentured servitude—or as a target in investigations uncovering the Cassalanter cult's dark financial web.
